note.p: One James Abbott lived on 32 Poland Street, according to the rate books for 1787-8. A James Abbott married Sarah on 6 September 1785 at St George Hanover Square. They had a son, William James, who was baptised on 4 December 1785 at St James. These dates overlap with another James Abbott, who married Elizabeth Ann Matthews (possibly signed ‘Mattheis’) on 9 September 1785. A witness was Peter Giffith. Both parties were of that parish and the marriage was by banns. Their children were baptised in St James: Louisa Ann 1790, Mary 1791 (possibly not Ann Elizabeth’s child as she was born only 7 months after Louisa Ann), Elizabeth Ann 1794, George 1800, and Ann, born Fulham 1803 (from a user-submitted tree on Ancestry). A Prerogative Court of Canterbury (PCC) will of a James Abbott, oilman of Bedford Street, Holborn, was proved on 25 August 1798 (dated 5 June 1798). The will mentioned his wife Elizabeth and was sworn to by James Bayley, perfumer, and William Bennett, gentleman, both of St Marylebone. There may be two or three different James Abbotts in these records.
